focus: Architected serverless cloud backends using AWS Amplify & AWS CDK, engineered high-throughput GraphQL APIs via AWS AppSync, and automated Amazon Bedrock pipeline delivery.
highlights: Architected serverless cloud backends using AWS Amplify and AWS CDK, automating branch-based preview and production environments.
Engineered high-throughput API workflows using AWS AppSync (GraphQL), Lambda, DynamoDB, and S3 with time-limited signed URLs.
Integrated Amazon Bedrock models into serverless pipelines, automating delivery via GitHub Actions with build caching.
